title: Action Comics #538 DC December 1982 Superman vs Jackhammer Rich Buckler Cover
condition_description: Bright front cover with light wear; back cover toned with a stain and small chips at the bottom right corner. See photos.
description:
Action Comics #538 (December 1982), DC Comics - Superman vs. Jackhammer, with Jimmy Olsen. Cover by Rich Buckler and Dick Giordano. 60 cent cover price.

Back cover: DC Super Heroes Time Sticks / Time Capsules / Watches ad.

Condition: bright front cover with light wear; back cover toned, with a stain and small chips at the bottom right corner (see close-up photo).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
